description: computing_core CI record (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record, tap#365) — the stack this plugin's own tests run in, and the one claim per-plugin CI is allowed to make: that computing_core is correct against the dependencies it DECLARES and nothing else. Install set is the depends_on closure (identity_core, the vocabulary dependency behind ASSIGNED_TO_HUMAN__computing_core, from git at a pinned commit) and computing_core; the consumer flips the self entry to editable so the CHECKOUT under test runs, not the pinned revision. Population seeds computing_core (seed-only, offline). DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED: every other plugin, all credentials, all required_secrets, and any population step that reaches the network — so a fork can run this lane and a nightly cannot flake on a third party (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record-5). Reproduce CI exactly: spawn --from 'git+https://github.com/unified-systems-com/tap-plugin-computing-core@v0.3.1#ci' --dev-plugins computing_core

plugins.note: Vocabulary dependency, pinned at the full commit of the v0.1.3 tag (this plugin's depends_on floor), the first release carrying identity_core__human. Credential-free.

Self, pinned like any app-of-apps record — the CONSUMER (plugin-ci boot-and-test, or `spawn --dev-plugins computing_core`) substitutes the checkout under test via tap.dev_workspace (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record-4). Booting this record unflipped runs the pinned revision.

steps.note: Own GRIFT: seeding it proves the bundle parses and its panel types resolve against a real registry.
